niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces with strong, explicit structure: clear visual hierarchy, obvious controls, and layouts that feel complete and intentional rather than empty or ambiguous. They consistently like screens where key actions are visible without hunting, sections are grouped into distinct cards or blocks, and important information is easy to scan through labels, compact rows, or strong typographic emphasis. They often respond well to richer, more feature-complete presentations when that density improves usability and hierarchy, especially in media, content, and creation tools. They also favor polished, expressive styling such as dark high-contrast themes, gradients, depth, and branded personality, but only when these support clarity rather than clutter.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers interfaces with clear top-down hierarchy, prominent primary content, supporting labels/subtitles/helper text, and obvious separation between major content levels.
Prefers screens where controls and next-step actions are immediately visible, explicit, and discoverable rather than hidden, ambiguous, or off-screen.
Prefers content organized into clearly separated, self-contained sections or cards that make categories and relationships easy to understand.
Prefers compact, efficient list rows and layouts that fit more information without feeling cramped, using alignment and concise presentation to improve scanning.
Prefers primary actions that are visually emphasized with stronger contrast, larger button treatment, or clearer placement over low-emphasis text links or muted buttons.
Prefers interfaces with a more premium, branded, and visually expressive aesthetic, including depth, gradients, cinematic layering, or stronger personality over flat generic presentation.
Prefers consistent icons, visual markers, and cues that reinforce meaning and improve recognition instead of relying on plain text or weak symbolic guidance.
